audit.why: 49.64% over 137 games. Quinn owns 1-3 as the ranged bully; from 4 onward Gwen's true damage, Hallowed Mist and scaling take over.

Both layers already read Quinn / Quinn / Quinn / Gwen / Gwen / Gwen / Gwen, which is exactly what the mirror (gwen__quinn) set. The packet's 'Skill' at level 3 is the odd one out and flipping it would break the mirror.
audit.corrected: No chart edit. Real numbers added instead: Hallowed Mist 22s at rank 1, Snip Snip! 6.5s, Skip 'n Slash 13s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page tells you to blind Snip Snip! so 'the true-damage burst misses'. It also spells the ability 'Snip Snip' and says Vault knocks you back.
audit.why: Snip Snip! is an ability cast in a cone, not a basic attack — nothing Blinding Assault does affects it, and Blinding Assault only hinders vision in the first place. Riot's Vault text has Quinn leaping off the target to land at her own maximum attack range; there is no knockback. Riot's real name carries the exclamation mark. Hallowed Mist means only enemies standing inside it can target her, so autos and Vault fail from outside.
audit.corrected: Trade advice re-keyed to Snip Snip!'s 6.5s cooldown instead of a blind, the real name used, Vault restated, and the Mist targeting rule written plainly.

audit.whatIsWrong: early, mid and late are all written in the first person ('I own levels 1-2', 'my range').
audit.why: Every other matchup on the site is second person; this reads as a different author and breaks the coaching voice.
audit.corrected: All three rewritten in second person at the same length.

edits.before: You own the opening — your range and Harrier auto-resets beat a melee Gwen who has no Snip Snip combo online yet.
edits.after: You own the opening — your range and Harrier auto-resets beat a melee Gwen with no Snip Snip! and no Mist yet.

edits.before: Q-blind, Vault, and W steroid are all up; punish her before she gets Mist (W) to hide in.
edits.after: Blinding Assault, Vault and the W steroid are up; punish her before Hallowed Mist exists.

edits.before: By 3 you both have your kits — your Q-blind-into-Vault trade is strong, but a smart Gwen can drop Mist mid-trade, so it's genuinely skill-tested.
edits.after: By 3 you both have kits — your Blinding Assault into Vault trade is strong, but she can drop Hallowed Mist mid-trade, so it is skill-tested.

edits.after: Levels 4-5 tilt to her — Snip Snip!'s centre cone deals true damage on a 6.5s cooldown and Mist shrugs off the chip between.

edits.after: Hallowed Mist is 22s at rank 1 — inside it only enemies in the mist can target her, so autos and Vault fail.

edits.before: Bully levels 1-3 with Q blind and Harrier E resets before she has Mist (W) to negate poke
edits.after: Bully levels 1-3 with Harrier autos and Vault before Hallowed Mist (22s) exists to negate poke

edits.before: Blind (Q) her Snip Snip (Q) auto-rhythm so her true-damage trade whiffs
edits.after: Step in while Snip Snip! is down — 6.5s with no true damage on her

edits.before: Gwen is melee and clunky pre-3, so I own levels 1-2 outright — my range and Harrier resets let me poke her every time she steps up for a creep. Bait her Snip Snip (Q) auto-cadence and Q-blind it so the true-damage burst misses, then E-Vault in for a Harrier proc and knock myself back out before she can E onto me. The one rule: respect her Hallowed Mist (W) — once she drops it I can't Vault or auto her, so commit my trade BEFORE she has it up.
edits.after: Gwen is melee and clunky pre-3, so you own levels 1-2 outright — your range and Harrier resets poke her every time she steps up for a creep. Trade on Snip Snip!'s 6.5s downtime rather than through it, because its centre cone is true damage: Vault in for the Harrier auto and let it land you an attack range away before Skip 'n Slash (13s) reaches you. The one rule: respect Hallowed Mist — from outside it you cannot target her at all, so commit before she drops it.

edits.before: My laning edge is real through 4-5 — keep shoving with Q and taking plates while she's still itemless. But at 6 the lane turns: her R Needlework fires from range and chunks me, and my R is a roam tool, not a duel button, so I can't answer her all-in burst with it. Use this window to leave lane and make plays elsewhere with my move-speed scout form instead of forcing a Gwen duel I no longer clearly win.
edits.after: Your laning edge is real through 4-5 — keep shoving with Blinding Assault and taking plates while she is still itemless. At 6 the lane turns: Needlework throws from 1200 and recasts twice, and your R is a roam tool, not a duel button, so it answers none of that burst. Use the window to leave lane and make plays elsewhere instead of forcing a Gwen duel you no longer clearly win.

edits.before: This is all Gwen. Once she has Riftmaker and Nashor's, her Q true damage shreds me and Hallowed Mist makes her untargetable whenever I dive in — I'm squishy with no front-to-back tools and she just outheals and outscales everything I do. My only path is to have already snowballed: take towers, roam with R, and try to end before her items arrive, because in a straight late-game fight a mist-and-burst Gwen kills me before I land my combo.
edits.after: This is all Gwen. Once she has Riftmaker and Nashor's, Snip Snip!'s true damage shreds you and Hallowed Mist leaves her untargetable the moment you dive — you are squishy with no front-to-back tools and she outheals everything you land. Your only path is to have already snowballed: take towers, roam with R, and end before her items arrive, because a mist-and-burst Gwen kills you before your combo finishes.

notes: Behind Enemy Lines shows cd 3 in the kit file, which is the ending/recast value rather than a real ultimate cooldown, so no number is printed for it anywhere — matching the mirror's decision.
